sn4.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
sn4.11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ ajjhokāse nisinno hoti. devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati.
sn4.11:1.3: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahante mahante pāsāṇe paggaḷesi.
sn4.11:2.1: atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn4.11:4.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
